WITH per_patient AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS acl_igm
    FROM Examination AS e
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
), deviations AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm,
           acl_igm - AVG(acl_igm) OVER () AS deviation
    FROM per_patient
), sex_averages AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, deviation,
           AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY SEX) AS sex_avg_deviation
    FROM deviations
), ranked AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, deviation,
           deviation - sex_avg_deviation AS excess,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY (deviation - sex_avg_deviation) IS NULL,
                        deviation - sex_avg_deviation DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM sex_averages
    WHERE deviation > sex_avg_deviation
)
SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, deviation, excess
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY (excess IS NULL), excess DESC;
